about: Modwerk source-only lfo-rnd package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/lfo-rnd.

mods.title: LFO RND
mods.summary: A second LFO page: two random modifiers per sound, each offsetting a chosen parameter by a new random amount on every note.
mods.description: LFO RND adds a page behind the LFO page key: press LFO again to reach it. It holds two random modifiers per sound. Each has a destination (DS1, DS2), one of sixteen parameters taken from stock's LFO destination list (the eight machine parameters, FIN, STA, FRQ, RES, DEC, PAN, DEL and REV), and a depth (DP1, DP2), 0 to 64 in sixteen steps. On every note trig each modifier draws a random offset between -depth and +depth for its destination, clamped to the parameter's range and held until the next note, on top of p-locks, slides and LFO 1. The settings are kept in the sound through core-ar2's mod storage. It is rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0004-lfo-rnd; from 1.2 its page and knobs go through core-ar2's page tables (core_pages, core_params, core_view_pages) instead of detours of its own.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: build P4A4 (core-ar2 0.4 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, this module at 1.2) passed the LFO RND page, its destination list, per-note offsets and the settings kept through save and power cycle; U4A4 (this exact source) passed core's page step. This package's own bytes, and the Modwerk base, have not been flashed from the site.
